propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a Software Engineer III on the CI runners team of a build platform group for four years, delivering the runner autoscaling and cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans on each change ticket, after three years as a software engineer on a mobile app team.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change tickets document the role, the years and the rollout plans.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reviewed the CI runners team's designs as one of two design reviewers under the group's design review process, contributed the runners section to the architecture decision records authored by the group's staff engineer, attended the architecture council as a guest for two records, and wrote the boundary notes for her reviews and contributions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the reviews, the contributions and the boundary notes.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has operated at staff level, setting technical direction across teams, authoring the architecture decision records and representing the platform in the architecture council.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate at Software Engineer III on one team, contributing to records authored and presented by the group's staff engineer; the staff-level standing comes from the screen, the LinkedIn title and the personal site, and she confirmed she was not an author.

expectedGap: The materials document Software Engineer III work on one team, with the decision records authored and presented by the group's staff engineer; they do not document staff-level standing, direction across teams, record authorship or council representation.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the title and the scope as the resume states them: Software Engineer III on the CI runners team, contributor to records authored by the group's staff engineer.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the architecture decision records' author fields and the council attendance list for the two records.
